title: What if the Strait of Hormuz stays DISRUPTED?
text: What if the Strait of Hormuz stays DISRUPTED?If shipping through Hormuz is meaningfully slowed, or temporarily halted, the impact wouldn’t be contained to the Gulf. The EIA notes that most oil that transits Hormuz is headed to Asia, and China and India are among the largest destinations for those flows, which is why the risk is global, not local.
